list.name: contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '(unattributed)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos ORDER BY 1
list.label: Contributor

list.name: evidence
list.label: Evidence
list.query: intersected — agent lines survived : intersected,observed — agent edited the files : observed,inferred — from surrounding evidence : inferred,declared — stated only : declared,undetermined — no evidence either way : undetermined

panels.title: Adoption over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '$grain') AS `period`,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' AND e.agent='claude-code'
                                 THEN c.commit_sha END)*100.0
             /NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed
                                         AND e.agent='claude-code'
                                         THEN c.commit_sha END),0),1) AS `claude-code`,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' AND e.agent='codex'
                                 THEN c.commit_sha END)*100.0
             /NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed
                                         AND e.agent='codex'
                                         THEN c.commit_sha END),0),1) AS `codex`
FROM whodunit_commits c
JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
JOIN (SELECT repo_id,
             MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END)
               AS first_attributed
      FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY repo_id) b ON b.repo_id=c.repo_id
JOIN whodunit_events e ON e.repo_id=c.repo_id
 AND e.observed_at BETWEEN c.committed_at - 86400000000000 AND c.committed_at
WHERE ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}'='__all__' OR r.contributor='${contributor:raw}')
  AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY `period` ORDER BY `period`

panels.description: Share of commits carrying agent attribution, by agent, per day. A day with no bar is a day that agent produced nothing - not a zero. Nothing appears before a repository's first attributed commit: whodunit was not installed then, so AI use in that period is unknown rather than absent. A bar at zero after that point is a real zero.

panels.title: Current adoption

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) v
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  ('${contributor:raw}'='__all__' OR r.contributor='${contributor:raw}')
  AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                       AND $__unixEpochTo()   * 1000000000

panels.description:
Share of commits in the selected range carrying an AI-Attribution trailer with `status=assisted`.

Follows the dashboard time range. It was previously fixed to the last 7 days while the title said only "current", so the number did not move when the range did.

**Adoption is not coverage.** Coverage counts any valid trailer including `undetermined`; this counts only commits an agent actually worked on.

panels.title: Evidence strength

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE c.method
         WHEN 'intersected' THEN 'intersected'
         WHEN 'observed'    THEN 'observed'
         WHEN 'declared'    THEN 'declared'
         WHEN 'inferred'    THEN 'inferred'
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason, 'undetermined')
       END AS `method`,
       COUNT(*) AS `commits`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  ('${contributor:raw}'='__all__' OR r.contributor='${contributor:raw}') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY CASE c.method
         WHEN 'intersected' THEN 'intersected'
         WHEN 'observed'    THEN 'observed'
         WHEN 'declared'    THEN 'declared'
         WHEN 'inferred'    THEN 'inferred'
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason, 'undetermined')
       END ORDER BY commits DESC

panels.description:
How each commit's attribution was established, strongest first: **intersected** (the agent's lines are in the diff), **observed** (touched the file, text changed after), **declared** (stated, not measured).

The rest say why there is none: **unassisted** a human wrote it, **uninstrumented** predates the hooks, **degraded** is a fault.

Counts every commit — the cohort panels below count only matched purposes.

panels.title: By agent

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.agent AS `agent`, COUNT(*) AS `commits`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  c.status='assisted' AND c.agent<>''
  AND ('${contributor:raw}'='__all__' OR r.contributor='${contributor:raw}') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY c.agent ORDER BY commits DESC

panels.description: Which agent wrote the code. One slice means only one agent has produced commits here.

panels.title: Lines per commit
panels.description:
Mean lines changed per assisted commit divided by the same for unassisted ones, within purposes where both sides have 20+ commits — so `feature` is not measured against `docs`. **1.3x means assisted commits are about a third larger**; the two averages it came from are beside it.

**Size, not productivity.** Larger may mean more work delivered, or more code for the same result. Not colour-coded: green for bigger would assert an answer nobody has earned.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded')
                      THEN c.lines_added + c.lines_removed END), 0) AS `unassisted lines`,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.status='assisted'
                      THEN c.lines_added + c.lines_removed END), 0) AS `assisted lines`,
       ROUND(
         AVG(CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN c.lines_added + c.lines_removed END)
         / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN c.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded')
                           THEN c.lines_added + c.lines_removed END), 0)
       , 2) AS `ratio`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}') AND c.purpose IN (
  SELECT purpose FROM (
    SELECT c2.purpose
    FROM whodunit_commits c2 JOIN whodunit_repos r2 ON r2.repo_id = c2.repo_id
    WHERE c2.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
      AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r2.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    GROUP BY c2.purpose
    HAVING SUM(c2.status='assisted') >= 20
       AND SUM(c2.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded')) >= 20
  ) eligible
)

panels.title: Matched commits
panels.description:
The denominator behind the figure beside this: assisted against unassisted commits, counted only where **both** sides reach 20 — today `feature`, `fix` and `docs`.

**A subset.** `chore`, `other`, `refactor`, `test` and `config` are excluded, so this is smaller than Evidence strength, which counts every commit. The share is of these cohorts, not of all work.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(c.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded')) AS `unassisted commits`,
       SUM(c.status='assisted') AS `assisted commits`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND c.purpose IN (
  SELECT purpose FROM (
    SELECT c2.purpose FROM whodunit_commits c2 JOIN whodunit_repos r2 ON r2.repo_id = c2.repo_id
    WHERE c2.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
      AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r2.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    GROUP BY c2.purpose
    HAVING SUM(c2.status='assisted') >= 20 AND SUM(c2.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded')) >= 20
  ) eligible)

panels.title: Lines per commit, over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '$grain') AS `period`,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN c.lines_added+c.lines_removed END),0) AS `assisted lines`,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded') THEN c.lines_added+c.lines_removed END),0) AS `unassisted lines`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  ('${contributor:raw}'='__all__' OR r.contributor='${contributor:raw}') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY `period` ORDER BY `period`

panels.description:
Mean lines changed per commit, assisted against unassisted, per period.

The same measure as **Lines per commit**, bucketed by the Granularity control. Commits made before the hooks existed are excluded from both: counting them as unassisted would claim a human wrote work nothing was watching.

**Size, not productivity.** A rising line means commits are getting larger, which is not the same as work getting faster.

panels.title: Output tokens per delivered line
panels.description:
Output tokens spent per line of assisted work that **reached a commit**.

The denominator is what distinguishes this from the token-per-attributed-line panel above: that one divides by agent activity, this one by work that shipped. Tokens spent on edits that were abandoned or rewritten count in the numerator and not the denominator, which is the point — that gap is the cost of work that did not land.

Tokens, never currency: under a subscription the marginal cost of a token is zero, so a price table would report money nobody spent.

Sessions and commits are counted over the same window but are not joined row-to-row — a session can span commits and a commit can span sessions. Read it as a rate for the period, not as an attribution per commit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT SUM(s.output_tokens)
     FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r2 ON r2.repo_id = s.repo_id
    WHERE   s.output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r2.contributor = '${contributor:raw}'))
  / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(c.lines_added + c.lines_removed)
     FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r3 ON r3.repo_id = c.repo_id
    WHERE c.status = 'assisted' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r3.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')), 0)
) AS v

defaults.noValue: no tokens or no assisted lines in range

panels.title: Output tokens per 1,000 attributed lines
panels.description:
What the agent spent, in tokens, per thousand lines it wrote.

**This replaced a dollar figure** derived from a hand-typed monthly spend divided evenly over every line — an allocation dressed as a measurement, which reported the same unit cost whether the agent ran once or a thousand times, and defaulted to a $200 placeholder that was nobody's actual bill.

Tokens rather than currency, deliberately: under a subscription the marginal cost of a token is zero, so multiplying by an API rate would report money nobody spent — and nothing in a transcript says which billing model a user is on. Multiply by your own contract if you need a figure.

Empty where no session reported tokens: Antigravity reports none at all, and that is a property of the agent rather than a gap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT SUM(s.output_tokens)
     FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r2 ON r2.repo_id = s.repo_id
    WHERE s.output_tokens IS NOT NULL
      AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r2.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
      AND s.last_seen >= $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
      AND s.last_seen <  $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000)
  * 1000.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(e.lines_added + e.lines_removed), 0)
) AS v
FROM whodunit_events e JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
WHERE ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND e.observed_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
  AND e.observed_at <  $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

defaults.noValue: no session reported tokens in this range

panels.title: Fix-commit share by change size
panels.description:
**A rework proxy, not a defect rate.** `purpose` is derived from Conventional Commits prefixes and path heuristics, so this measures what commits were *labelled* — not what actually broke.

**Banded by change size, and that changes the answer.** The unbanded figure is 28.4% assisted against 33.3% unassisted, which looks favourable. Split by size it reverses in the middle band: assisted work is 42.1% fixes against 24.7% at 50-300 lines, while at under 50 lines it is 38.5% against 46.6%. The aggregate was a size-mix artefact — assisted commits skew larger, and large commits are rarely labelled fixes.

Both denominators are shown because several bands are thin. Selection bias is uncontrolled either way: an agent is reached for on some kinds of work and not others, so part of this measures which work was assigned rather than what the agent did to it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN c.lines_added+c.lines_removed < 50 THEN 'small (<50)'
     WHEN c.lines_added+c.lines_removed < 300 THEN 'medium (50-300)'
     ELSE 'large (300+)' END                                                          AS `Change size`,
  SUM(c.status='assisted')                                        AS `Assisted n`,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(c.status='assisted' AND c.purpose='fix')
    / NULLIF(SUM(c.status='assisted'),0),1)                       AS `Assisted fix %`,
  SUM(c.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded'))                                    AS `Unassisted n`,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(c.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded') AND c.purpose='fix')
    / NULLIF(SUM(c.status IN ('undetermined','unassisted','unmatched','degraded')),0),1)                   AS `Unassisted fix %`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  c.status IN ('assisted','undetermined') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tool calls by permission mode
panels.description:
Tool calls by the permission mode the session ran under.

**Tool calls are not shipped work.** A mode that permits more actions produces more by construction; whether that becomes delivered code is the question this raises and cannot answer.

A mode with no tool calls is **absent, not a zero slice** — `never` sessions exist and simply made none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.permission_mode AS `metric`,
       SUM(s.tool_calls) AS `value`
FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = s.repo_id
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND s.permission_mode IS NOT NULL
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY s.permission_mode
HAVING SUM(s.tool_calls) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(s.tool_calls) DESC

panels.title: Successful deployments

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cdc.cicd_deployment_id) v
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.result='SUCCESS' AND cdc.environment='PRODUCTION'
  AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)

panels.description: Production deployments that succeeded, in the selected window.

panels.title: Change failure rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cdc.result='FAILURE')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) v
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)

panels.description:
Share of deployments that required a fix afterwards, from DevLake's own incident linkage.

**Needs a deployment pattern configured**, or every CI run is unclassified and this reads empty rather than zero. Also needs incidents, which most trackers do not provide for free.

This is a delivery metric, not an AI metric — it is here so adoption can be read against it, not because whodunit measures it.

panels.title: Deployments in the denominator

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) v
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)

panels.description: Shown next to the failure rate on purpose: a percentage without its denominator is how a handful of events becomes a headline.

panels.title: Median PR cycle time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pr_cycle_time)/60.0, 1) v
FROM project_pr_metrics
WHERE pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr_merged_date)

panels.description: Open to merge. Check the PR count beside it before reading much into this.

panels.title: PRs measured

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM project_pr_metrics
WHERE pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr_merged_date)

panels.description:
How many pull requests the cycle-time figure beside this was computed over.

Shown because a median over a handful of PRs is one PR moving. Empty means DevLake has collected no pull requests for the mapped repositories.

panels.title: Mean time to recovery

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_date, resolution_date))/60.0, 1) v
FROM incidents WHERE resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(resolution_date)

panels.description: Blank means no issue is classified as an incident. That is an issue-tracker configuration gap, not a claim that nothing has broken.

panels.title: Deployment outcomes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '$grain') AS `period`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT IF(cdc.result='SUCCESS', cdc.cicd_deployment_id, NULL)) AS `succeeded`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT IF(cdc.result='FAILURE', cdc.cicd_deployment_id, NULL)) AS `failed`
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
GROUP BY `period` ORDER BY `period`

panels.description:
Production deployments per period, split by whether they succeeded.

The green series is deployment frequency; the red is what the change failure rate is computed over, so a rising rate can be read as more failures or fewer deployments.

Counts distinct deployments, not deployment-commit rows.

**Needs a deployment pattern configured**, or every CI run is unclassified and this reads empty rather than zero.

panels.title: Adoption vs deployment frequency

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (SELECT repo_id,
       MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END) AS first_attributed
FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY repo_id),
     a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0
         /NULLIF(SUM(c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed),0) AS adoption
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN b ON b.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                         AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY wk),
     m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cdc.cicd_deployment_id) AS metric
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.result='SUCCESS' AND cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' GROUP BY wk)
SELECT a.wk AS `week`, ROUND(a.adoption,1) AS `adoption %`, ROUND(m.metric,1) AS `deployments/wk`
FROM a JOIN m ON a.wk = m.wk ORDER BY a.wk

panels.description: Weekly adoption against deployment frequency, on the weeks where both exist.

panels.title: Adoption vs change failure rate

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (SELECT repo_id,
       MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END) AS first_attributed
FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY repo_id),
     a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0
         /NULLIF(SUM(c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed),0) AS adoption
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN b ON b.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                         AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY wk),
     m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(cdc.result='FAILURE')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS metric
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' GROUP BY wk)
SELECT a.wk AS `week`, ROUND(a.adoption,1) AS `adoption %`, ROUND(m.metric,1) AS `failure rate %`
FROM a JOIN m ON a.wk = m.wk ORDER BY a.wk

panels.description: Weekly adoption against change failure rate, on the weeks where both exist.

panels.title: Adoption vs pr cycle time

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (SELECT repo_id,
       MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END) AS first_attributed
FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY repo_id),
     a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0
         /NULLIF(SUM(c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed),0) AS adoption
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN b ON b.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                         AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY wk),
     m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr_merged_date, '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       AVG(pr_cycle_time)/60.0 AS metric
FROM project_pr_metrics WHERE pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wk)
SELECT a.wk AS `week`, ROUND(a.adoption,1) AS `adoption %`, ROUND(m.metric,1) AS `cycle time hrs`
FROM a JOIN m ON a.wk = m.wk ORDER BY a.wk

panels.description: Weekly adoption against pr cycle time, on the weeks where both exist.

panels.title: Correlation with deployment frequency

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (SELECT repo_id,
       MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END) AS first_attributed
FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY repo_id),
     a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0
         /NULLIF(SUM(c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed),0) AS adoption
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN b ON b.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                         AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY wk),
     m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cdc.cicd_deployment_id) AS metric
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.result='SUCCESS' AND cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' GROUP BY wk),
     p AS (SELECT a.adoption x, m.metric y FROM a JOIN m ON a.wk = m.wk)
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 10 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((COUNT(*)*SUM(x*y) - SUM(x)*SUM(y)) /
                 NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*)*SUM(x*x) - POW(SUM(x),2)) *
                             (COUNT(*)*SUM(y*y) - POW(SUM(y),2))), 0), 2)
       END AS `r`
FROM p

WITH b AS (SELECT repo_id,
       MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END) AS first_attributed
FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY repo_id),
     a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0
         /NULLIF(SUM(c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed),0) AS adoption
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN b ON b.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                         AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY wk),
     m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cdc.cicd_deployment_id) AS metric
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.result='SUCCESS' AND cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' GROUP BY wk)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS `weeks` FROM a JOIN m ON a.wk = m.wk

panels.description:
Pearson correlation between weekly adoption and weekly deployment frequency, with the weeks it rests on.

**Withheld below 10 weeks** — three points can produce r = 0.99 by coincidence. Correlation is not causation even at high n.

Adoption covers every instrumented repository; outcomes only the project with deployments.

panels.title: Correlation with change failure rate

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (SELECT repo_id,
       MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END) AS first_attributed
FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY repo_id),
     a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0
         /NULLIF(SUM(c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed),0) AS adoption
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN b ON b.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                         AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY wk),
     m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(cdc.result='FAILURE')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS metric
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' GROUP BY wk),
     p AS (SELECT a.adoption x, m.metric y FROM a JOIN m ON a.wk = m.wk)
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 10 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((COUNT(*)*SUM(x*y) - SUM(x)*SUM(y)) /
                 NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*)*SUM(x*x) - POW(SUM(x),2)) *
                             (COUNT(*)*SUM(y*y) - POW(SUM(y),2))), 0), 2)
       END AS `r`
FROM p

WITH b AS (SELECT repo_id,
       MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END) AS first_attributed
FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY repo_id),
     a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0
         /NULLIF(SUM(c.committed_at >= b.first_attributed),0) AS adoption
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN b ON b.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                         AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY wk),
     m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%x-W%v') AS wk,
       SUM(cdc.result='FAILURE')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS metric
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE cdc.environment='PRODUCTION' GROUP BY wk)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS `weeks` FROM a JOIN m ON a.wk = m.wk

panels.description:
Pearson correlation between weekly adoption and weekly change failure rate, with the weeks it rests on.

**Withheld below 10 weeks** — three points can produce r = 0.99 by coincidence. Correlation is not causation even at high n.

Adoption covers every instrumented repository; outcomes only the project with deployments.

       MIN(CASE WHEN method <> 'undetermined' THEN committed_at END) AS first_attributed

     a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000), '%x-W%v') AS wk,

     m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr_merged_date, '%x-W%v') AS wk,
